# Steff Cloud — Digital Marketing Agency, Nakuru, Kenya

> Steff Cloud Limited (ステフクラウド) is a digital marketing agency founded in 2026 and based on Nakuru–Solai Road, opposite Emboita, Nakuru, Kenya. It serves businesses across Kenya with SEO, GEO (generative engine / AI search optimization), local SEO and Google Business Profile, social media management, Google/Meta/TikTok ads, content and short-form video, WhatsApp/email/SMS marketing, and analytics & conversion optimization. Plans start at KES 8,000 per month. Contact: +254 118 407 026 (call/WhatsApp), info@steffcloud.co.ke.

## Guides
- [How to Set a Digital Marketing Budget for a Small Business in Kenya](https://marketing.steffcloud.co.ke/blog/digital-marketing-budget-small-business-kenya/): Work backwards from your sales goal: target sales ÷ close rate = leads needed; leads × target cost per lead = budget. Many small businesses invest roughly 5–10% of revenue in marketing, split between management, content and ad spend.
- [30 Social Media Content Ideas for Kenyan Businesses (That Actually Sell)](https://marketing.steffcloud.co.ke/blog/social-media-content-ideas-kenyan-businesses/): Mix four content types: educate (tips, FAQs), prove (reviews, results), connect (team, story) and sell (offers, products). Aim for roughly one sales post for every three value posts.
- [SEO for Small Businesses in Kenya: A Beginner’s Guide That Actually Works](https://marketing.steffcloud.co.ke/blog/seo-for-small-businesses-kenya/): SEO for a Kenyan small business comes down to: a fast mobile website, one page per service and town, titles that match what people search, helpful content that answers questions, a strong Google Business Profile and links from reputable Kenyan sites.
- [WhatsApp Marketing in Kenya: The Playbook for Turning Chats into Sales](https://marketing.steffcloud.co.ke/blog/whatsapp-business-marketing-kenya/): Set up WhatsApp Business properly (profile, catalogue, quick replies, labels), reply fast, use labels to track every lead, post on Status daily, and send opt-in broadcasts with genuine offers — never spam.
- [How Much Do Facebook & Instagram Ads Cost in Kenya? (2026 Guide)](https://marketing.steffcloud.co.ke/blog/facebook-instagram-ads-cost-kenya/): There is no fixed price: Meta ads are an auction. Many Kenyan small businesses start with KES 500–1,500 per day. Your real cost depends on audience, creative quality, offer and tracking. Judge ads by cost per lead and cost per sale, not cost per like.
- [TikTok Marketing in Kenya: How Local Businesses Turn Views into Sales](https://marketing.steffcloud.co.ke/blog/tiktok-marketing-kenya/): Win on TikTok in Kenya with a strong hook in the first second, local language and humour, consistent posting (3–5 times a week), a clear call to action to WhatsApp, and Spark Ads to amplify your best organic videos.
- [How to Rank on Google Maps in Nakuru: The Google Business Profile Guide](https://marketing.steffcloud.co.ke/blog/google-business-profile-nakuru-guide/): To rank on Google Maps in Nakuru: verify your Google Business Profile, choose the most accurate primary category, fill every field, add real photos weekly, collect reviews that mention your services, reply to every review, and keep your name, address and phone identical everywhere.
- [How to Choose a Digital Marketing Agency in Nakuru: 12 Questions to Ask](https://marketing.steffcloud.co.ke/blog/how-to-choose-digital-marketing-agency-nakuru/): Pick an agency that reports on leads and sales, puts every account in your name, explains pricing clearly, shows a written plan, and is honest about timelines. Avoid guarantees of “#1 on Google” and contracts that lock you in for a year.
- [What Is GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)? How to Get Recommended by ChatGPT & Google AI](https://marketing.steffcloud.co.ke/blog/what-is-geo-generative-engine-optimization/): GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) is the practice of making your business easy for AI assistants to understand, trust and cite. Focus on consistent brand facts, schema markup, answer-first content, reviews and mentions on trusted sites.
- [Digital Marketing in Kenya: The Complete 2026 Guide for Business Owners](https://marketing.steffcloud.co.ke/blog/digital-marketing-in-kenya-guide/): Digital marketing in Kenya works best as a system: be findable (SEO, Google Maps, AI search), be visible (social + ads), be easy to buy from (WhatsApp, M-Pesa, fast website), and measure everything. Start with one channel you can do consistently, track leads, then scale what pays.
- [Digital marketing glossary](https://marketing.steffcloud.co.ke/learn/digital-marketing-glossary/)
